A flow-inserted stage on those would add a cycle to every priced static-join edge age (die_ages.json / kv_static_ages) that the compiled calendar does not have.  KV-PC3 sr6: no waiver left -- pc__fi (fault chain, hck), pc__ki (kc kick word, hck) and x__est__0_1 (embedding boot-ready, ck) land in RTL face registers (fi_q / ki_q / ebr_q, +1 edge each, handed to the die schedule): gate pc_h_sr3 164813 + its sr6-boundary CTS rerun measured those cones at SS -437 / -181 / -168 ps.
